title: REST API
prompt: Implement CRUD routes with validation, pagination, not-found responses, and centralized error handling. Submit a small source snippet or focused implementation excerpt and verify the runtime behavior locally. CodeLeaf only performs a limited static pattern check here; it does not execute learner code.
target_skills: Implement CRUD routes with validation, pagination, not-found responses, and centralized error handling

starter.run_instructions: Use a separate local Node.js project. Place the snippet in an appropriate .mjs file, provision any named package/file/service, and run documented normal/error cases. The platform does not execute arbitrary code.

public_tests.name: Required source markers
public_tests.note: A static marker check is not a substitute for executing tests in a separate isolated environment.

acceptance_criteria: The implementation addresses the stated task and uses the intended Node.js API/pattern.
Input and expected output or observable behavior are documented.
At least one relevant failure, boundary, authorization, or resource-cleanup case is addressed.
The example is tested locally with a supported Node.js version before being considered complete.
hints: Write down the expected result before running the code.
Keep input validation and error handling close to the boundary where data enters.
Test one normal input and one failure or edge case.
status_note: Limited static-pattern assessment. No arbitrary-code execution is provided by the current CodeLeaf playground.
